title: External Air Pump Installation
body_html:
1. Replace the Internal Air Hose Connection

Note: This procedure is only required for X Series machines. Models such as the Hydra do not require any modification to the internal air hose connection.

  • Remove the right-side and rear enclosure panels of the X Series machine. Then locate the built-in air pump and the internal air hose connection.
  • As shown in the image, disconnect the air hose connected to the built-in air pump and connect the air hose from the external air pump instead.

Note: Press the white retaining ring before pulling out the air hose.

  • Reinstall the right-side enclosure panel.

 

2. Connect the Air Pump to the Machine

  • An air pump port is located on the rear of the machine. Locate the port and connect the air hose securely.

(The image on the left shows the air pump port on the XRF model, and the image on the right shows the air pump port on the Hydra model.)

 

3. Connect the Air Pump to Power

  • Connect the air pump to an appropriate power source according to its electrical requirements.

Note: The Hydra model is equipped with a dedicated power outlet for the air pump, allowing it to power the air pump directly. The XRF model does not have an air pump power outlet, so the air pump must be connected to a separate power source.
